title: GetSibu — Creative Asset Management Platform
text: GetSibu is an intelligent creative asset management platform designed to help teams store, organise, search, review and collaborate on videos, images, documents and audio from one central workspace. Instead of depending on scattered folders, disconnected drives and complicated naming systems, GetSibu creates a searchable creative library where teams can quickly locate the right asset and understand its context.

sourceTitle: The Operating System for Creative Libraries
title: The Operating System for Creative Libraries
text: GetSibu acts as an operating system for modern creative libraries by bringing storage, organisation, AI tagging, search, collaboration, permissions and analytics into one platform. Creative teams can connect existing storage sources, import assets, automatically process media and make the resulting library available to authorised team members.

title: AI-Powered Digital Asset Management
text: GetSibu combines digital asset management with artificial intelligence to make large creative libraries easier to understand. AI-assisted tagging, scene detection, OCR, semantic search, face grouping and duplicate detection help teams organise information that would otherwise require extensive manual work.

title: Creative Library Management
text: A growing creative team can quickly accumulate thousands of videos, images, documents and audio files. GetSibu provides a structured environment where those assets can be organised through folders, tags, collections, metadata and permissions, creating a reliable source of truth for the entire organisation.

title: Intelligent Media Library
text: GetSibu transforms a conventional media library into an intelligent information system. Instead of searching only by filenames, users can search using descriptions, visual characteristics, extracted text, tags, people, colours, scenes, formats and other available metadata.

title: Centralised Creative Asset Library
text: GetSibu provides one central location for creative assets from connected drives, local infrastructure and direct uploads. By bringing assets together, teams can reduce the confusion caused by multiple storage locations and disconnected versions of the same file.

title: Modern Digital Asset Management
text: Traditional file storage focuses primarily on keeping files available. GetSibu extends that concept by adding AI-assisted organisation, contextual search, collaboration, approvals, version history, analytics and permission controls specifically designed for creative workflows.

title: Creative Asset Organisation
text: GetSibu helps teams organise creative assets using structured folders and scalable taxonomies. Hierarchical tags, synonyms, colours and inheritance make it possible to create an organisation system that remains useful even when the library grows to thousands or millions of assets.

title: AI-Aware Asset Management
text: AI-aware asset management allows GetSibu to analyse media and recommend meaningful tags and classifications. Teams can approve AI suggestions in bulk, override them when necessary and maintain control over how their library is organised.

sourceTitle: One Source of Truth for Creative Teams
title: One Source of Truth for Creative Teams
text: GetSibu gives creative, marketing, production and brand teams a shared source of truth for their digital assets. Everyone works from the same organised library, while permissions and approval workflows help ensure that users access and distribute the right content.

title: Creative Asset Search
text: GetSibu makes creative assets searchable through filenames, metadata, OCR, AI-generated tags, comments and semantic information. Users can search for a specific asset or describe what they need in natural language and let the platform interpret the request.

title: AI Asset Discovery
text: AI asset discovery helps users find files based on what appears inside the asset rather than depending entirely on manually entered metadata. This is particularly useful when teams have large libraries containing thousands of visually similar files.

title: Media Search Platform
text: GetSibu provides a dedicated search experience for creative media. Users can combine keywords and filters related to file category, format, uploader, resolution, date and other available information to narrow large result sets quickly.

title: Semantic Creative Search
text: Semantic search allows users to describe the type of asset they want using natural language. A request such as "warm urban evening footage" can be interpreted according to available embeddings and AI-generated media information rather than relying only on exact keyword matching.

title: OCR-Powered Asset Search
text: GetSibu extracts text from images, PDFs, presentations and screenshots so that the content becomes searchable. This allows users to locate documents and visual assets even when the required information exists inside the file rather than its filename.

title: Search Across Creative Libraries
text: Teams can search across their entire creative library rather than manually opening folders one at a time. Search results can combine different information sources to make asset discovery faster and more flexible.

title: Saved Asset Searches
text: Frequently used searches can be saved and shared through a URL. This makes it easier for teams to create reusable views for campaigns, clients, products, content categories and other recurring workflows.

title: Natural Language Asset Search
text: Natural language search lets users describe assets in the way they naturally remember them. Users do not have to know the exact filename if they remember characteristics such as colour, scene, subject, location or campaign context.

title: Advanced Media Filters
text: GetSibu provides filters that can narrow results according to categories, formats, sources, resolutions and dates. Filters can be combined to progressively reduce a large library into a relevant collection of assets.

title: Fast Asset Discovery
text: GetSibu is designed around fast asset discovery, including sub-second search performance across large libraries. The platform combines search indexing, metadata and AI-assisted retrieval to reduce the time spent looking for files.

title: Creative Asset Indexing
text: When assets enter GetSibu, the platform processes available metadata and prepares them for search and organisation. This creates an indexed representation of the library that can support faster discovery.

title: Media Metadata Management
text: Metadata such as EXIF, XMP, file paths, creators and custom keywords can become part of the asset record. This helps preserve context and improves the usefulness of a migrated or newly created library.

title: Asset Metadata Search
text: Users can search available metadata alongside tags and extracted content. This gives creative teams multiple ways to find an asset when the original filename or folder structure is unknown.

title: Creative File Discovery
text: GetSibu helps teams discover images, video, audio and documents through a unified search experience. The platform is designed to reduce the dependency on folder knowledge and individual team members remembering where files were stored.

title: Searchable Video Library

title: Creative Library Navigation

title: Asset Discovery Workflow

title: Why Invest in GetSibu
text: GetSibu combines AI-powered discovery, centralised asset management, collaboration, analytics and security into one platform designed specifically for creative workflows.

title: What Is Digital Asset Management?
text: Digital asset management is the structured process of storing, organising, finding, managing and distributing digital content. GetSibu extends traditional DAM with AI-assisted tagging, semantic search and collaboration.

title: What Is AI Asset Management?
text: AI asset management uses machine intelligence to analyse and classify digital content, making large libraries easier to search and organise.

title: What Is Semantic Search?
text: Semantic search allows users to search by meaning and context rather than relying only on exact keyword matches.

title: What Is AI Tagging?
text: AI tagging automatically suggests labels based on what the system detects in an asset.

title: What Is Scene Detection?
text: Scene detection identifies distinct sections or scenes within video content so users can navigate large files more efficiently.

title: What Is OCR in DAM?
text: OCR converts text visible inside images and documents into searchable information.

title: What Is Face Grouping?
text: Face grouping identifies recurring people across media collections and groups related assets together.

title: What Is Duplicate Detection?
text: Duplicate detection identifies files that are identical or visually equivalent, including some renamed or re-encoded copies.

title: What Is Asset Versioning?
text: Asset versioning maintains previous versions of a file so teams can understand its history and restore earlier versions when necessary.

title: What Is Creative Approval?
text: Creative approval is a workflow where authorised users review assets and confirm that content is ready for use.

title: What Is Creative Governance?
text: Creative governance establishes rules around asset ownership, permissions, approvals, retention and usage.

title: What Is Multi-Tenant DAM?
text: Multi-tenant DAM allows one platform to support multiple isolated organisations or clients.

title: What Is a Creative Library?
text: A creative library is a central repository for images, videos, documents, audio and other digital content.

title: What Is Asset Metadata?
text: Asset metadata is information describing a file, including creator, format, dimensions, keywords and other contextual details.

title: What Is Asset Taxonomy?
text: An asset taxonomy is a structured classification system that defines how digital content is grouped and labelled.

title: What Is a DAM Migration?
text: DAM migration is the process of moving an existing digital asset collection into another asset management environment.

title: How AI Changes DAM
text: AI changes digital asset management by making visual and textual content more discoverable without requiring every piece of metadata to be entered manually.

title: Future of Digital Asset Management
text: The future of DAM is moving toward intelligent systems that understand content, automate organisation and provide more contextual search.

title: Future of Creative Collaboration
text: Creative collaboration is increasingly moving into platforms where feedback, approvals, versions and assets exist together.

title: Future of AI-Powered Creative Libraries
text: AI-powered creative libraries can become more than storage systems by acting as intelligent knowledge environments for an organisation's creative content.

title: What Is GetSibu?
text: GetSibu is an AI-aware digital asset management platform for storing, organising, searching and collaborating around videos, images, documents and audio.
